data.promptProse: Composed in a sweeping vertical full-body frame inside a high-rise hotel suite at night, Shiki Natsume stands barefoot beside a towering floor-to-ceiling window dotted with glowing raindrops, her midnight-blue silk robe slipped into a soft pool around her ankles. Completely nude save for her twin red hairclips and a delicate silver bracelet, she turns three-quarters toward the viewer with rare, unhurried tenderness as cool silver skyline light traces a luminous rim down her silhouette and a warm bedside lamp gently lights her face.
data.story: 暗蓝真丝睡袍顺着脚踝滑落在地。三十层高空的雨夜灯火在落地窗外化成一片银蓝光海，夏目只留发间两枚红色发夹，转过身来坦然望进你眼底，神情平静而温柔——「既然决定把以后都交给你，就没有什么需要藏起来的了。」
